notes: %VarFmtLst (the 61-field TDF FORMAT/INFORMAT list) and %ReadTDFCSV (the fixed-shape INFILE/INPUT reader for Test Definition File CSVs) are copied verbatim into autoexec.sas. script.sas writes a small, non-PII mock TDF CSV inline (5 item rows spanning ELA grade 3 and Math grade 5, using real TDF column names: AssessmentType, Subject, StudentGrade, Claim, Target, DOK, WorkflowStatus, etc.) instead of reading from the author's SharePoint-synced Prebuild_TDF folder, then calls %ReadTDFCSV exactly as the file's own commented-out usage does, followed by a %StudyTDF-style PROC SQL WHERE/ORDER BY subset on Subject='MATH' and StudentGrade=5 (adapted from the file's own %StudyTDF macro further down in the same file).
